notes: pdf_status is not-available rather than archived because the download failed, not because the licence forbids it. The version of record is open access under CC BY 3.0 per Crossref and per Unpaywall, which gives https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1088/1741-2552/aadea0/pdf as the best open-access location with licence cc-by. Two fetch attempts against that URL, the second with a browser user agent and a matching referer, both returned HTTP 200 with content-type text/html and a 14371-byte Radware Bot Manager captcha page rather than a PDF. Re-attempt from a browser session. Because no publisher PDF was obtained, source.md is instead a markitdown conversion of the arXiv preprint, arXiv:1805.06427 v1 dated 16 May 2018, fetched from https://arxiv.org/pdf/1805.06427 (403671 bytes). That preprint is under arXiv's default non-exclusive licence, read from the abs-license block on https://arxiv.org/abs/1805.06427 which links http://arxiv.org/licenses/nonexclusive-distrib/1.0/, so it too could not be committed even though it is the document that was read. The card cites the version of record and flags that the preprint may differ from it. One substantive consequence is recorded on the card: the WithinSession, CrossSession and CrossSubject evaluation class names that later MOABB documentation uses do not appear anywhere in this preprint, which implements only within-session five-fold cross-validation. md_quality is rough: the two-column IEEE-style layout was converted into interleaved pseudo-tables with most prose lines chopped into cells, inter-word spaces frequently deleted, and the arXiv side-stamp inlined as reversed text. All four figures are lost; the per-dataset p-values in Figures 2 and 3 survive as loose numeric columns but the effect-size bars do not, so the direction and magnitude of each dataset's effect is unrecoverable and only the p-values and meta-effect p-values are quoted. Figure 4's axis labels are shredded into vertical character runs. Tables I and II are recoverable but pipe-mangled, with several rows falling outside the table markup.
